params.name: Pitch
params.desc: Adjusts the pitch of the oscillator

params.name: Mod Type
params.usage: 0: Saw wave; 1: Square wave; 2: Triangle wave; 3: Random pitch; 4: Noise decay; 5: Decline ramp

params.name: Wave
params.desc: Select sine or triangle wave oscillator type

params.name: Pan
params.desc: Pans between left and right channel

params.name: Low Boost
params.desc: Boosts then distorts the low end while cutting high end frequencies

params.name: Motion Seq
params.desc: Selects from off, smooth, trig hold

params.name: Type
params.desc: Selects from default delay, motion seq delay, tempo delay

params.name: Depth
params.desc: Sets the depth of the delay effect

params.name: Ring Mod 1
params.desc: Toggles ring mod on synth 1 and synth 2

params.name: Ring Mod 2
params.desc: Toggles ring mod on synths 4 with audio tracks

params.name: Mute Synths
params.desc: Mute or unmute any combination of synths with a single message

params.name: Mute PCM/Audio
params.desc: Mute or unmute any combination of drum samples or audio inputs with a single message
